{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First few 'revenue' values:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Preview the distribution of revenue values
print("\nRevenue value examples:")
print(sales['revenue'].unique()[:15])"}
